```javascript
async function syncReadingToServer(reading) {
  try {
    const userId = reading.user?.name || "anonymous";

    await fetch(API_URL, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ userId, reading }),
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Failed to sync reading to server", err);
  }
}
```
